summary: Run bounded observation and usage retention chunks as background writer work

schema.detail: No tables, indexes or stored data formats change.

rules.detail: Retention cutoffs, newest-observation protection and per-subject limits are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The three retention writer loans use the shared background admission class and release between chunks. Foreground request classification and transaction behavior are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No restart migration or downtime is required.

recovery.detail: No active writer is preempted; interrupted retention resumes through the existing chunked trim process.
